common.loadFailed: The server did not answer. Check that it is running, then try again.

setup.title: Set up this server
setup.intro: Create the first administrator. The server printed a one-time setup token to its log when it started.
setup.tokenHelp: Find it in the server log, for example with: docker compose logs server
setup.usernameRule: 3 to 100 letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores, or {'@'}
setup.passwordShort: The password needs at least 12 characters.
setup.totpIntro: Scan the code with an authenticator app, or type the key into it, then enter the code the app shows. You will need a code at every sign-in.
setup.qr: QR code for your authenticator app

signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: Administrators sign in with a password and a code from their authenticator app.

overview.title: Server overview
overview.intro: This is the admin panel of your Tildeck sync server. It shows the state of the server; it never shows the contents of anyone's vault.

database.label: Database
database.ok: The server can reach its database.
database.unknown: The server did not report the state of its database.

areas.users: Accounts, their devices, and the storage they use.
areas.activity: Every sign-in, change, and administrative action.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Everyone with an account on this server. Vaults are encrypted on the users' devices: you see how much they store, never what.

user.disableBody: Every device of this account stops syncing at once. Nothing is deleted, and you can enable the account again.
user.enableBody: The account's devices can sync again.
user.deleteBody: The account, its devices, and every synced item are deleted from this server for good. Vaults already on the user's devices stay there, locked with the master password.
user.revokeBody: The device stops syncing at once, and the account owner gets an email about it.
user.totpBody: Do this only when the owner lost the authenticator app and asked you, after checking it is really them. Signing in will need only the master password until they turn it on again. They get an email about it, and the activity log records it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: How this server runs. A value set in the server's environment wins and cannot be changed here; secret values are never shown.
settings.secretSet: A value is set. Type a new one to replace it.
settings.lockedHelp: Set in the server's environment. Change it there and restart the server.

public_url.label: Public address
public_url.help: The https address apps and emails use to reach this server.

registration_mode.label: Registration
registration_mode.help: Who may create an account. Open registration needs email.

smtp_host.label: SMTP server
smtp_host.help: The host name of the mail server.

smtp_port.label: SMTP port
smtp_port.help: Usually 587 with STARTTLS, or 465 with TLS.

smtp_security.label: Connection security
smtp_security.help: How the connection to the mail server is encrypted.

smtp_username.label: SMTP username
smtp_username.help: Leave empty if the mail server needs no sign-in.

smtp_password.label: SMTP password
smtp_password.help: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

smtp_from.label: Sender address
smtp_from.help: The address every email comes from.

device_idle_days.label: Device idle limit
device_idle_days.help: Days a device may stay unused before it must sign in again.

signin_limit_per_account.label: Failed sign-ins per account
signin_limit_per_account.help: Allowed in 15 minutes before the account is paused.

signin_limit_per_address.label: Requests per address
signin_limit_per_address.help: Account requests allowed from one address in 15 minutes.

activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: Everything that happened on this server, newest first. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.

actions.totp_reset: Two-factor sign-in turned off by an administrator

errors.database_unavailable: The server cannot reach its database. Check the database container and the connection settings.
errors.unsupported_protocol: This app version cannot sync with this server. Update the app or the server.
errors.invalid_setup_token: That setup token is not right. Copy it again from the server log; it changes at every restart.
errors.setup_not_needed: This server already has an administrator. Sign in instead.
errors.invalid_totp: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and enter the current code.
errors.invalid_credentials: The username, password, or code is not right.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: The page lost its session token. Reload the page and try again.
errors.setting_locked: This value is set in the server's environment and cannot be changed here.
errors.invalid_request: That value is not valid here.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_email: That email address does not look right.
errors.email_taken: This address already has an account.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.intro: Invite someone by email address. The code works once, for that address only, within 7 days, and registering with it confirms the address. Registration must be set to invitation or open.
invites.emailed: The code was sent to this address.
invites.notEmailed: Email is not configured: send this code yourself.
invites.onceOnly: It is shown only now, and works until {date}.
invites.revokeBody: The code stops working at once.
